questions.question: What should you do if a traffic officer signals you to stop, but the traffic light is green?
questions.explanation: You must always obey a traffic officer. A traffic officer's instruction is more important than any traffic light or road sign.

questions.question: What should you do if your brakes fail while driving downhill?

options.text: Use the handbrake and shift to a lower gear

questions.explanation: Use your handbrake and shift to a lower gear to slow the vehicle down. Turning off the engine or accelerating would make the situation worse.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a chevron road marking?

options.text: To indicate areas where parking is allowed
To warn of sharp bends or hazards ahead

questions.explanation: Chevrons warn you of a sharp bend or a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does a blue rectangular sign with a white 'P' indicate?
questions.explanation: The white 'P' stands for parking, not a petrol station or a pedestrian crossing.

questions.question: What should you do if you encounter a stop-and-go system at roadworks?

options.text: Ignore the stop sign and proceed carefully
Stop and wait for the signal to proceed

questions.explanation: A person at the roadworks turns a sign that shows STOP on one side and GO on the other. If it shows STOP, stop and let the oncoming traffic through; move off only when it shows GO.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow arrow at a traffic light mean?

options.text: Proceed with caution in the direction of the arrow
Ignore the arrow and follow the main light

questions.explanation: The video gives 'proceed with caution in the direction of the arrow'. Note: the NaTIS manual does not list a flashing yellow (amber) arrow. It lists a constant amber arrow (stop and wait until the flashing green arrow shows you may go) and a flashing amber disc (drive on carefully, but yield to pedestrians).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals, Traffic lights (p.56)

questions.question: What is the purpose of a rumble strip on the road?

options.text: To reduce vehicle speed and alert drivers

questions.explanation: Rumble strips are placed on the road, for example near roadworks or areas with a lot of foot traffic, to make drivers slow down and pay attention.

questions.question: What should you do if a vehicle in front of you suddenly stops?

options.text: Maintain a safe following distance and stop if necessary

questions.explanation: Keeping a safe following distance gives you enough time to slow down and stop if the vehicle in front suddenly stops. Swerving into the next lane could cause an accident.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign with a picture of falling rocks mean?
questions.explanation: The falling rocks sign warns that rocks could fall onto the road in this area. Slow down so that you can stop if a fall occurs.

questions.question: What should you do when entering a freeway?

options.text: Speed up to match the flow of traffic
Stop and wait for a gap
Enter without checking for other vehicles

questions.explanation: Speed up to match the flow of traffic (without breaking the speed limit) so that you can merge safely.

questions.question: What does a circular sign with a red border and a white background indicate?
questions.explanation: Look at the shape and colours: a round sign with a red border and white background is a prohibition (restriction) sign. Warning signs are triangular.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign with a red border and a picture of children walking mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that children might be crossing the road, for example near a school. Reduce your speed and look out for children.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign with a picture of a car and squiggly lines mean?
questions.explanation: The squiggly lines represent skid tracks: the road surface ahead may be slippery.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign with a train on it mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular warning sign with a train warns of a railway crossing ahead.
